name: CANDY BOW-DOT
source:
She has no friends. Total loner. Total demon, and total angel. Born under mysterious circumstances, she has decided to let her life be controlled entirely by the true divine RNG: heavier than heaven, gooder than God; RNG is everywhere, and it is everyone; with every flip of her "Moose or Seals" coin, another timeline is created. Another Candy Bow-dot is created. Another demonic eye is added underneath another eyepatch. Her heart beats for possibility, and accepts all possibility. This is what it means to worship RNG. Emotional. Passionate. Insanely powerful EGO. Brainhack is total. Cutie is total, too.

Blessed by RED.
